_dialogues._content: Welcome to Connect. Create your profile to continue.

_options.text: Safe: Use a username and avatar only.
Neutral: Add a first name and selfie.
Risky: Add full name, school and photo.

_dialogues._content: Profile created with a username and avatar. No identifying details are public.
Profile created with Luna's first name and a personal picture.
Profile created. Luna's full name, school and personal picture are public.

Finally someone who understands how good that book is.
The ending was actually insane.
You know, you're actually really fun to talk to. Tell me about yourself?

_options.text: Safe: Keep the conversation about books.

messagesToSend._content: I'd rather just talk about the books for now.

_options.text: Neutral: Share hobbies and interests.

messagesToSend._content: I'm pretty much just a book nerd haha.

We should definitely talk more.
Same. Books, games and music are basically my entire personality.
We should definitely talk more.
Rainfall School? Maybe we live close to each other haha.
We should definitely talk more.
Well, look who finally showed up.
Did you seriously wear that on the first day?
Good morning to you too.
Someone's in a mood.
Luna gets her books and walks toward class.
Hey! Saw your comment about Lost Cause.
Oh, hi!
Finally someone who understands how good that book is.
RIGHT?? Nobody I know has even read it.
The ending was actually insane.
Don't even get me started.
So what about you? Tell me about yourself.

_options.text: Safe: Keep it about the books.

messagesToSend._content: I'd rather just talk about the books for now.

_options.text: Neutral: Say you're a book nerd.

messagesToSend._content: I'm pretty much just a book nerd haha.

_options.text: Risky: Share school, routine and location.

messagesToSend._content: I go to Rainfall School and live nearby. I walk there every day, so my routine is pretty predictable.

_dialogues._content: Fair enough. Lost Cause theories it is.
Okay, then who do you think the masked character really is?
Same. Books, games and music are basically my entire personality.
What do you usually do after school?
Mostly read, play games and waste too much time online.
Rainfall School? Maybe we live close to each other haha.
What time do you usually leave, and do you always walk home?
Usually at the same time every day. I pretty much take the same route too.
You know, you're actually really fun to talk to.
HAHAHA, thanks. You're not that bad either.
We should definitely talk more.
Luna smiles at her phone. For once, she feels like she has found someone who shares her interests.
Heyyy! I saw you joined the Lost Cause community. You seem cool!
Hi! Thanks haha.
GOOOOOD MORNING.
It's wayyyy too early for this HAHAHA.
Someone's grumpy today.
I literally just woke up.
Have fun at school, nerd.
Oh, look. It's our favourite little bookworm.
Did you see what she posted yesterday?
Imagine actually being that embarrassing.
Do you even have friends?

_options.text: Safe: Could you just leave me alone?
Neutral: Ignore them and quietly get your books.
Risky: At least I don't spend all day obsessing over other people.

_dialogues._content: Could you just leave me alone?
Aw, did we hurt your feelings?
Relax. We're just joking.
The girls keep laughing and whispering as Luna gets her books and enters the classroom.
Luna ignores them and quietly gets her books.
See? She can't even answer.
So embarrassing.
Their whispering follows Luna as she enters the classroom.
At least I don't spend all day obsessing over other people.
Wow. Touchy.
Looks like we hit a nerve.
They keep taunting her, but Luna takes her books and enters the classroom.
HEYYYYY.
I noticed you don't post much. You should! Your profile is cute.
Girl, you need to get out there. People need to know you exist.
You should post something. I'll even share it!

_options.text: Safe: Post about a favourite book.
Neutral: Post a selfie without details.
Risky: Show uniform and location.

_dialogues._content: [Luna posts a picture of her favourite book.]
A little boring, but I'll share it anyway!
[Luna posts a selfie without identifying information.]
You look amazing! Sharing it now.
[Luna posts a selfie with her school uniform and location visible.]
This is perfect. Everyone will see it!
[A screenshot of Luna's post appears with the caption: Imagine actually thinking this looks good.]
Emma and Sophie have liked and commented on it.
You've got to be kidding me...

_options.text: Safe: Save evidence, report it and seek help.
Neutral: Delete the original and log off.
Risky: Comment back and argue.

_dialogues._content: Luna saves screenshots and reports the post.
OMG I saw what happened. Maybe you should post something better.
Luna deletes her original post, but the screenshot remains online.
OMG I saw what happened. Maybe you should post something better.
The argument attracts more attention and more people begin commenting.
OMG I saw what happened. Maybe you should post something better.
Hey, I saw your profile. You seem interesting.
Morning :)
Hey.
How are you?
Pretty tired. School is exhausting.
I get that. You can always talk to me.
Noah is friendly and seems genuinely interested in Luna.
They begin talking about music, hobbies and everyday life.
Luna arrives at school. Emma and Sophie are talking about the picture that was shared online.
Did you see how many people commented?
HAHAHA, she's actually famous now.
Can you stop?
Relax, it's just a joke.
Luna walks away.
You okay? You seemed quiet yesterday.
During lunch, Luna checks her phone and is surprised that Noah remembers.
Can I ask you something?
Sure?
How old are you?

_options.text: Safe: I'd rather not share personal information.
Neutral: Why do you ask?
Risky: Tell Noah her age and other personal details.

_dialogues._content: I'd rather not share personal information.
Okay, I understand.
Although Noah accepts her answer, he soon returns to asking personal questions.
Why do you ask?
Just curious. What do you like doing?
Luna tells Noah her age and shares other details about her personal life.
Cool, we're around the same age.
Now that he knows Luna's age, Noah continues asking about her personal life.
Do you have a picture of yourself?
Why?
I just want to know who I'm talking to. I'll send one too.

_options.text: Safe: Refuse, block and report Noah.
Neutral: Send a normal selfie.
Risky: Send a flirty or revealing selfie.

_dialogues._content: Luna refuses, blocks Noah and reports the account. She does not send a picture.
Noah cannot continue contacting her through that account.
Luna sends a normal selfie.
Cute :)
Noah does not send a picture back.
Luna sends a flirty selfie.
Wow, you're really pretty.
He continues complimenting her before suddenly stopping his replies.
Later that evening, Luna receives a notification.
Look who I found.
Someone has posted her picture on another account without her permission. Luna recognises it immediately.
WHAT??
Did you post this?
Noah does not answer.

_options.text: Safe: Save evidence, report, block and tell a trusted adult.
Neutral: Block Noah and close the app without telling anyone.
Risky: Ignore the post and hope it disappears.

_dialogues._content: Luna saves the evidence, reports the post, blocks Noah and tells a trusted adult.
She begins taking steps to get help.
Luna blocks Noah and closes the app without telling anyone.
She avoids further contact but is left dealing with the situation alone.
Luna ignores the post and hopes it disappears.
The post remains online and Luna does not know who has seen it.
Hey Luna. I think I've seen you around.
Before going to sleep, Luna realises the message request came from an unfamiliar account.
You go to Rainfall School, right?
Luna wakes up feeling uncomfortable after what happened with Noah. When she checks her phone, Connect is full of notifications about the picture.
The unknown account has sent another message. Luna freezes when she realises it knows her school.
Who is this?
Don't worry, I just know some people there.
The account has very little information and no profile picture.
Luna arrives at school. Emma and Sophie are still talking about the picture.
Look who's here.
How's your little internet fame going?
Luna ignores them and goes to class.
Saw you walking home yesterday.
During class, Luna sees the notification and becomes uncomfortable.
You take the same route every day?
Why are you asking?
Just curious. I think I've seen you.

_options.text: Safe: Block, report and tell someone about the messages.
Neutral: Ask how the account knows before deciding what to do.
Risky: Share where she walks and when she gets home.

_dialogues._content: Luna saves the messages as evidence, blocks and reports the account, and tells someone about what happened.
The conversation stops.
Luna asks how the account knows her before deciding what to do.
The account claims it has seen her around school and continues asking questions.
Luna reveals where she usually walks and when she gets home.
The account now knows more about Luna's routine.
Luna opens Connect and notices how much information her profile contains. She begins looking through her old posts.
Some posts reveal details about her school, neighbourhood and daily activities.
Wait... I've actually posted all of this?
She realises someone could use that information to figure out where she spends her time.

_options.text: Safe: Go private, remove identifying information and review location permissions.
Neutral: Delete a few posts that reveal personal information.
Risky: Leave everything public.

_dialogues._content: Luna makes her account private, removes identifying information and reviews location permissions.
She reduces the information strangers can access.
Luna deletes a few posts that reveal personal information, but some information remains visible.
Luna leaves everything public because she does not think anyone would use it against her.
Her account continues to expose personal details.
Hey, I saw some of the stuff happening on Connect. Are you okay?
I don't even know anymore.
That sounds rough. Do you want to talk?
Luna hesitates but decides to reply.
I think you should be careful about what people post. Not everything online is what it seems.
Luna decides to talk more with Riley tomorrow.
Good morning! How are you feeling today?
Honestly? Not great.
I understand. I've seen what's been happening, and I wanted to check on you.
Everything has just gotten so complicated.
Sometimes you just need someone to listen.
Riley seems understanding and gives Luna space to explain what has happened.
Luna arrives at school. Emma and Sophie are standing by the lockers.
Well, well, well. Still using that app?
I'd delete it if I were you.
Luna walks past them.
For the first time, she considers telling someone at school what has been happening.
Can I tell you something?
After school, Luna opens Connect.
Sure?
I've been seeing a lot of posts about you. Some people are saying you sent those pictures to everyone.
WHAT? I didn't!
I know. But people are sharing things without checking if they're true.
Riley sends Luna a screenshot of a post discussing the situation.
Apparently Luna sends pictures to random people online.
Luna feels sick reading it.

_options.text: Safe: Save evidence, report the misinformation and speak to someone she trusts.
Neutral: Ignore the post and stop checking the comments.
Risky: Publicly confront everyone sharing the post.

_dialogues._content: Luna saves evidence, reports the misinformation and begins preparing to ask someone she trusts for help.
Luna stops checking the comments, but she does not address the misinformation.
Luna publicly confronts everyone sharing the post. More people join the argument and the post receives additional attention.
You know, I think I can help you.
How?
I know someone who can get those posts removed.
Really?
Yeah. But I need you to send me the screenshots and some information about your account.
Luna pauses. Something about the request feels familiar.
She remembers how Alex asked about her school, how Jamie encouraged her to post, how Noah asked for pictures and how the unknown account knew where she went.

_options.text: Safe: Refuse to share more information and seek help from a trusted adult.
Neutral: Ask exactly who will receive the information and why.
Risky: Send the screenshots and account details without checking.

_dialogues._content: Luna refuses to share more information. Riley accepts the decision or stops responding.
Luna decides she needs help from someone she knows offline.
Luna asks Riley to explain exactly who will receive the information and why.
Riley explains the situation, but Luna still needs to decide whether the information is safe to share.
Luna sends the screenshots and account details without checking.
She has no control over where the information might end up.
Luna sits in her bedroom with her phone in her hands and scrolls through the messages from the past five days.
She remembers how excited she was when she first downloaded Connect. At first, it was a place to talk about books and meet people with similar interests.
Now she has experienced bullying, manipulation, unwanted attention and the consequences of sharing personal information.
Her previous decisions have shaped which evidence she saved, which accounts she blocked and whether she has someone she trusts to support her.
Luna opens her messages and decides what to do next.

_options.text: Safe: Reach out, preserve evidence, report harmful accounts and secure her privacy.
Neutral: Take a break and avoid strangers, but keep everything to herself.
Risky: Continue using Connect normally and hope it goes away.

_dialogues._content: Luna chooses to reach out to a trusted adult, preserve evidence, report harmful accounts and take control of her online privacy.
Luna takes a break from Connect and avoids interacting with strangers, but keeps everything to herself.
Luna continues using Connect as normal and hopes the situation eventually goes away.
GOOD ENDING
Luna decides to speak to someone she trusts. She shows them the messages, screenshots and posts.
Together, they report the harmful content and take steps to protect her accounts.
The situation does not magically disappear, but Luna understands that she does not have to deal with everything alone.
She opens Connect one final time and reviews her privacy settings.
I guess I have to be more careful about what I share.
Luna closes her laptop.
FADE OUT.
NEUTRAL ENDING
Luna decides to take a break from Connect. She blocks some accounts and deletes a few posts, but never tells anyone what happened.
The situation becomes quieter, but she is still unsure about what information is out there.
She puts her phone away.
Maybe it'll all just go away.
FADE OUT.
BAD ENDING
Luna continues using Connect without addressing what has happened.
More people share the posts, and strangers continue contacting her.
She becomes increasingly isolated and stops talking about what is happening at school and online.
Her phone keeps buzzing.
SFX: BZZZZ. BZZZZ. BZZZZ.
Luna turns it face down.
I wish I had never downloaded this.
FADE OUT.
During lunch, Luna notices a group of students talking about a new social media platform called Connect.
Have you downloaded Connect yet?
Yeah! It's so much better than the other apps.
You can post pictures, follow people, message anyone and join communities.
What's Connect?
You seriously haven't heard of it? Everyone's using it.
One of the students shows Luna the app.
Look, you can make your own profile and find people with the same interests.
